title: Applying Churn Rate Analysis from Software Engineering to AI Security Tool Adoption

original_idea.body:
# Applying Churn Rate Analysis from Software Engineering to AI Security Tool Adoption

**Problem:** Organizations adopt and abandon security tools frequently. Software engineering churn metrics could quantify whether AI security tools are retained or replaced, which is a proxy for their real-world effectiveness.

**Direction:** Analyze public GitHub repositories (using GitHub API) for changes in security tool configurations (presence/absence of Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, Dependabot configs) over 12-month windows. Compute churn rate. Correlate with repository characteristics (language, size, stars).

**Why it matters:** If AI security tools have high churn, they may not be delivering sustained defensive value. This is measurable proxy evidence about real-world adoption and effectiveness.

**Relevant context:** Software engineering research extensively studies tool adoption patterns. Security tool churn specifically has not been studied in this framing.
